name: Claude Opus 5 (Fast)
description: Claude Opus 5 is the latest model in Anthropic's Opus family and a step-change improvement over Opus 4.8. It delivers major gains over Opus 4.8 in agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and long-horizon reasoning, and it is stronger per token across effort levels.
